subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KM-PJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc56623818050134188b24c5a7a4ff9c8ced024bea3b7857915b876b34cd4ba5.png] 

Option 2) OQ-TN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b25b75de88436a506c2491edc0d755619f0324b756f82311b005dc1dc68f586.png] 

Option 3) IK-NH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7906a8e0d5d8d12bdf20f1c80d79f5bd906ce0f3d34a550e7d0f45ceb249ec61.png] 

Option 4) GI-LE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41d3d8e693ddc99d72c23486eea78918277e4ef23d55fd9698e24d7bc8f170a6.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'GI-LE is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
